model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of participants associated with different criteria, labeled along the vertical axis. The vertical axis is labeled "Criterion" and lists nine categories in descending order: "Relevant FCs," "FC Summary," "Relevance Explanation," "Clarity and Simplicity," "Overall Summary," "Filters," "Veracity Explanation." The horizontal axis, labeled "Number of Participants," displays values on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at each whole number. Each criterion is represented by a horizontal bar exhibiting a different color; “Relevant FCs” is represented by a dark gray bar with a length corresponding to approximately 6 units; “FC Summary” by a medium gray bar with a length of approximately 5 units; "Relevance Explanation" and "Clarity and Simplicity" are both represented by light gray bars with a length of approximately 3 units; “Overall Summary” is represented by a green bar of length 2 units; “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” are both represented by light green bars of length 1 unit. The bars are sorted by decreasing value, with the tallest bar corresponding to "Relevant FCs" and the shortest bars corresponding to "Filters" and "Veracity Explanation."
